lessons: When a collaborator's PR targets your branch and they go offline, merge it and apply the requested fix yourself; leaving it open costs the user a confusing branch tangle.
A user asking 'why local, can't we Vercel' needs the mental model (where code lives vs where it runs) before any command; commands alone don't unconfuse.
Design exploration canvases need a direction question before implementation; implementing 'the file' is not a task.
Windows CI is slower; thread-timing tests must assert on state classes, not exact states, and waits should wake on state changes.
